infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Physio Buddy uses the camera to record short clips of your movement for on-device posture analysis.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Physio Buddy records audio along with video clips; audio itself isn't analyzed.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Physio Buddy can analyze movement clips you already have in your photo library.
